propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets, intercept ladder, and regex-based generation, creating parser/help drift risk and maintenance burden
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help and rebar help <command> reports them unknown while handler-owned --help is inconsistent and may execute work
Parser grammars must be derived from single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory used by both runtime execution and build-time help generation to eliminate manual syntax authority
Help and unknown-command paths must return byte-current generated package data before operation/config/mount/handler boundaries without composing operations or mounting
Optional modes and backends must advertise capabilities via separate registry mapping to packaging extras and missing postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) without eager optional imports

Migration must use expand/contract by command family with shadow parity and derived compatibility exports, proceeding in phases from foundation through execution cutover to retirement of duplicate authorities
